DESIGN PROTOTYPE
Legal entity federation / Design edition 04

Evidence for each legal and physical boundary.

Receipts must identify both the recipient entity and the actual storage destination.

Audit evidence

FieldPurpose
Owner entity + global customer IDWhich authoritative relationship is governed.
Recipient entityWho receives the operational projection.
Source and destination storeWhere the crossing actually occurs.
Policy generation + placement versionWhich rules and binding authorised the operation.
Decision, reason, field profile, timestampExplain permission, denial or purge.
Delivery / purge acknowledgementSeparate intended state from confirmed destination state.

Custody rules

Source denials remain at the source. Destination audit contains scoped identifiers only after legitimate contact; it never copies the owner-only notes. A never-authorised store receives no customer-specific receipt. Generic fleet metadata can be globally governed separately from customer evidence.

Retention is not a delete button

A revoked projection can remain in MVCC history, backup archives, immutable audit and prior operational systems. Define retention owners and legal-hold behaviour for each surface. Cryptographic erasure requires a validated key hierarchy and retention protocol; it is not provided by deleting the live row.

PoC limit

Audit is a regular SQL table. Append-only roles, integrity chains, immutable export and retention controls are not implemented. Do not describe the prototype audit as tamper-evident.

HAND OFF TO ENGINEERING

A focused prompt with scope, contracts and acceptance criteria.

Read the full prompt
Design edition 04: 30 synthetic bank legal entities (UK 3, Asia 8, Americas 3, MENAT 5, rest of Europe 11), mapped independently to three physical PoC stores in Singapore, London and New York. Asia assumes one entity in each of eight countries. All names, mappings and country rules are illustrative, not legal advice or bank policy. Preserve global customer identity; master key is (owner_entity_id, global_customer_id); projection key additionally includes destination_entity_id. Sharing a store or global ID does not share entitlements. OPA evaluates entity grants AND resolved physical country restrictions, with deny override. The downloadable implementation is a single Python/FastAPI harness, three independent CockroachDB single nodes, three OPA engines, outbox polling and OpenTelemetry. The hosted monitor is a labelled browser simulation. Local HA, Java regional services, CDC/Kafka, distributed fencing and signed permits are production extension work. The original v3 catalog planner does not execute migrations. Edition 08 adds an isolated executable relocation slice and optional fourth store; see Entity relocation. Automatic geography failover remains prohibited.

Define a regionally retained evidence schema including both legal entity and physical store. Make audit append-only for application identities, add integrity verification and approved immutable export. Test exclusion across audit, trace, dead-letter, backup and support surfaces; report retention conflicts explicitly.
